name: Competitor pricing changed
summary: When a competitor's pricing page changes: analyse what it means, then draft a battlecard update, a comparison-page update, an email to at-risk customers and a sales talk track. Each draft waits for approval before it goes anywhere.

inputs.label: Battlecard Google Doc ID
inputs.help: The long ID in the doc's URL: docs.google.com/document/d/<ID>/edit. Approved updates are appended to it.

inputs.label: At-risk customer emails
inputs.help: Who the email draft is addressed to. It is saved as a Gmail draft; you send it.

inputs.label: Sales channel Slack webhook URL
inputs.help: An incoming webhook for the sales channel (Slack → Apps → Incoming Webhooks).

inputs.label: Only these competitors (optional)
inputs.help: Comma-separated names from the Competitors page. Blank = all.

config.system: You are a competitive-intelligence analyst for a B2B software company. Be specific, short and factual; never invent numbers that are not in the input.
config.prompt:
These competitor pricing pages changed since the last check (lines starting with + were added, - removed):

{{outputs.watch.text}}

Explain:
1. What changed, old versus new.
2. What it means for us.
3. Which kinds of our customers are most at risk of switching, and why.
4. What sales should say about it.

config.system: You write our public comparison pages.
You write short, honest customer emails.

nodes.name: Save the email as a Gmail draft
Post the talk track to sales
